name: Potassium aluminium sulfate
description: Potassium aluminium sulfate (CAS 10043-67-1 ), commercially known as potassium alum and approved as E522 , is an inorganic double salt used across food, water treatment, and industrial processing. It functions primarily as a coagulant, astringent, and pH buffer, with performance characteristics that suit both regulated food-grade and heavy-duty industrial applications. In water treatment, it acts as a flocculant to aggregate particles. This process clarifies drinking water and wastewater streams effectively. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a firming agent and leavening component in baked goods, pickled products, and starch-based formulations. Tanneries and leather processors apply it as a primary tanning and preserving agent. Its astringent action fixes hides without the environmental burden of chromium-based alternatives, making it a preferred choice in the industry. In textile dyeing, it functions as a mordant to bond dyes to natural fibers, improving wash fastness and color consistency. Potassium aluminium sulfate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or as larger crystals. Recognized grades include food-grade ( FCC ), USP , and technical-grade, with anhydrous and dodecahydrate forms both available commercially. Buyers typically specify grade and crystal size based on dissolution rate requirements. The material is also available in compliance with Ph.Eur. , BP , EP , and ACS standards upon request.
